correctness.rationale: The counterexample uses the source's left Hilbert-module convention exactly. The projection P:A→Ap is adjointable with P* the inclusion. For every T in End_A^*(A,Ap), A-linearity gives T(P*P)=T, so the singleton {P} satisfies the operator-module frame identity with bound 1. At q=(0,1), Pq=0 while <q,q>=q is nonzero positive, so the lower g-frame inequality fails. The sufficient repair is verified by an explicit adjoint formula for rank-one maps.

value.rationale: The equivalence is a central structural theorem of the article and is presented as a Hilbert-C*-module generalization of a Hilbert-space result. The counterexample is finite-dimensional at the C*-algebra level, uses a nonzero operator module and an exact Parseval operator frame, and isolates the mechanism lost in the generalization. The unit-vector hypothesis supplies a concise reusable repair that recovers the rank-one reachability available in the precursor setting.
